correctness.rationale: Exhausted all 2^15 edge subsets independently under the 20 forbidden 3-edge triangles; obtained face vector (1,15,105,435,1125,1773,1560,660,105,10) in degrees -1..8. Constructed oriented ∂6 (1560x660) and ∂7 (660x105) from faces, checked ∂6∂7=0, and obtained ranks over F2: rank∂6=564; over F3: rank∂6=565, rank∂7=95. Hence 565 ≤ rank_Q∂6 ≤660-rank_Q∂7 ≤565. Independent invertible elimination modulo 4 yielded precisely 564 odd pivots and an even residual with 630 entries 2 mod4 and no odd entries. The sole additional nonzero Smith invariant is 2 times an odd unit (not a multiple of 4); torsion of coker ∂6 is exactly Z/2 at the 2-primary part. Exact sequence 0→H5→coker∂6→im∂5→0 with im∂5 free transfers torsion to H5. Finite exhaustion is valid for this finite complex, but not a statement about all graph counts.

value.rationale: The K3-free graph-property complex on six labeled vertices is an intrinsically motivated canonical finite object. Determining its exact fifth integral two-primary torsion is a natural homology invariant not supplied by rational Betti numbers or graph-colorability wedge results, and it disproves a possible wedge-of-spheres homotopy form for this object. This is a substantive integer-homology calculation, not arbitrary recomputation of an unrelated six-vertex simplicial table.
residual_risks: Value is confined to one naturally minimal small graph-property complex; no complete odd-torsion census or family theorem is claimed.
